purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Every object declares trade-shipment, transport-consignment or combined-logistics-view.
Shipment and consignment remain distinct identities connected by many-to-many item allocation.
Goods, handling units, inventory, movement, trace, documents, declarations, claims and evidence remain external masters.
Tracking status, events, sensors and documents remain evidence rather than automatic master truth.
WM-FLW-004 remains a compositional reference and WM-OBJ-021 containment remains membership only.
Mode, jurisdiction, customs, dangerous-goods, safety, privacy and conformance profiles remain deferred.
Every external projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The aggregate preserves stable identity, mandatory semantic kind, party and endpoint boundary, revision and successor lineage.
Many-to-many allocation supports split shipments and consolidated consignments without merging their identities.
Item quantities, package and handling-unit membership, movement references, requirements, status and measures are separately represented.
Custody, possession, control, responsibility and ownership cannot be inferred from one another.
Plan, prediction, observation, actual milestone, record time and correction remain independent assertions.
Reconciliation appends differences and corrections instead of last-write-wins.
Protected commercial and location projections are deny-by-default and purpose-bound.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
